steps.what: Inspect the actual wallboard, joints, required finish and site conditions, checking the work instruction and clarifying any specified wall system or material constraint with the responsible supervisor.

Read the actual sealing-compound and tape labels and applicable manufacturer instructions, checking product identity, compatibility, intended use and condition rather than relying on an assumed material match.

Select the correct sealing compound or tape for the actual wallboard and finish requirements, resolve any incompatible or unavailable choice with the supervisor and retain the existing specification decision rights.

tasks.design: Keep site inspection, original product-instruction reading and material selection with the taper. A catalogue or form would not remove the actual compatibility checks, so no software change is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selection depends on the actual wall system, product and site conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing work and product instructions are sufficient; no new enabler is claimed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise when the available material does not suit the specified wall system.
tasks.human_edge: Connect instructions with the physical joint and expected finish.

ambition.what: No expanded specification or substitution authority.

tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in material selection duties.

evidence.claim: Material selection requires checking actual product applicability and site context rather than substituting a catalogue match for physical inspection.

assumptions: Boundary is material selection through the actual choice, not purchasing, application, a specification change or a site-quality report. Shares are illustrative, not measured. No routine written selection record, report, send or commit is required by this statement; none is hidden in the physical work or invented as a saving.

Existing work instruction supplies wall system and required finish; actual product labels and manufacturer instructions supply product identity and applicable use. Taper verifies actual site and product conditions in s1-s2. Missing or unclear details require direct source reading and supervisor clarification, retained in those steps.

Native catalogue access and fixed lookup tables were considered first. They cannot remove these actual short label checks or site judgement without evidence of repeated searching, and no such duplication is established. Every current action retains full time. No change means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Actual specified wall system and product availability
research_questions: Is there real repeated product searching beyond the actual packaging and work-instruction checks?

already_counted.description: Actual site assessment, product-instruction checks and selection remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: No software change or additional upkeep is proposed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The actual inspection, label reading and selection remain fully counted. No removable written or administrative action has been established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check the actual adhesive identity, packaging and storage condition against its manufacturer instructions and intended wallboard use, clarifying any uncertain product or site restriction.

Check adhesives on the actual material and site conditions through the existing prescribed inspection or suitability check, observing workability and bond-related evidence rather than inferring performance from a product name.

Evaluate whether the adhesives will work and remain durable using the actual observations and product limitations, reject or escalate a doubtful product and seek further evidence where immediate checks cannot establish long-term suitability.
outputs: taper's suitability finding and unresolved concerns

tasks.design: Retain the actual product, substrate and suitability checks. A native checklist could display the existing instructions but would not establish durability or remove the physical observations, so no change or saving is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adhesive performance depends on actual product and substrate conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing manufacturer instructions and prescribed checks remain the means; no new enabler is claimed.
tasks.still_hard: An immediate check cannot establish every long-term durability outcome.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertain evidence and avoid treating an assumption as verified performance.

ambition.what: No automatic acceptance or new warranty authority.

reach.task: Clarify the evidence for an adhesive concern

evidence.claim: A checklist or product lookup does not replace actual substrate and adhesive observations or prove long-term durability.

assumptions: Boundary is actual adhesive checking through its suitability finding, not material selection in task 13541, adhesive application or a separate quality-assurance report. No action is counted twice. Shares are illustrative.

Product labels/manufacturer supply identity, applicable instructions and stated limitations. Taper obtains actual storage/substrate conditions and observations in s1-s2. Missing instructions or uncertain evidence require direct clarification or further prescribed checks counted in those steps; no generated durability conclusion is assumed.

Native checklists and product lookup were considered first. No repeated manual lookup or record transport is established. The statement requires no routine written report, send or record commit; a separate site-report duty, if present, must be analysed separately rather than hidden here. All existing physical and judgement time remains, and no change means zero upkeep.
research_questions: What evidence does the current process actually obtain before judging adhesive suitability?

already_counted.description: Actual product/context checks, physical observations and suitability judgement remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: No proposed change introduces additional upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual checking and judgement keep full time; no removed manual or record action is established and no durability inference is automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Tapers retain direct material selection and suitability checking with no established software saving.
reach: Clarify installed wall systems with drywall installers
Discuss doubtful suitability evidence with building inspectors
skills_to_grow: Clear treatment of uncertain material performance
role.ambitious_version: Use actual product and site evidence for careful finishing decisions within existing trade responsibilities.
